data.title: Start Lux directly from the selected branch
data.body: Start Lux from the selected branch checkout (main by default) with automatic profile and build isolation. Remove reserved-version and refresh procedures. Preserve running scenes and other processes. Verify launcher isolation, MCP pairing, skill installation and independent review.
data.summary: Start Lux directly from the selected checkout. Isolate profile, build output and MCP instance automatically. Remove reserved-version refresh workflow. Both shipped skills reinstalled and verified. Independent Sol review passed after fixes.
data.evidence: Commit d9d97c158c7f77b089a35b9a7042849306662a73 on main. Nine focused tests passed. Real isolated Studio startup, same-instance reuse and stdio MCP discover/status/read passed; development dist bytes unchanged; owned test process exited. Raw harness and result: C:/Users/zFlei/repos/lux/.worktrees/_coordination/start-simple/qa.mjs and qa.json. Independent reviewer /root/review_start (Sol medium for cross-module startup risk) verified receipt session pinning, slow-launch retry guard, bounded private build output and documented runtime boundary. Both skill install --check outputs current. git diff --check passed.
data.qa: No UI appearance change. Existing user sessions retained. Compiler and SDK still read selected checkout; use another checkout for development while it runs. Standalone desktop packaging and Lux branding were discussed as follow-up, not delivered here.
